import ast
import math
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\certification.py')
tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'CertificationRegistry')
method = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'budget')
alpha = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'round_alpha')
namespace = {'math': math}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[alpha, method], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
db.execute('CREATE TABLE rounds (k INTEGER, state TEXT)')
class Registry:
    _alpha = .05
    _registry_id = 'test'
    budget = namespace['budget']
    @contextmanager
    def _transaction(self):
        with db:
            yield db
r = Registry()
keys = {'registry_id', 'alpha', 'rounds', 'allocated_alpha', 'remaining_alpha', 'next_round_alpha'}
assert set(r.budget()) == keys
assert r.budget(include_open_rounds=True)['open_rounds'] == 0
db.executemany('INSERT INTO rounds VALUES (?, ?)', [(1, 'open'), (2, 'closed'), (3, 'open')])
base = r.budget()
assert base == r.budget(include_open_rounds=False)
assert set(base) == keys
assert r.budget(include_open_rounds=True) == dict(base, open_rounds=2)
assert type(r.budget(include_open_rounds=True)['open_rounds']) is int
try:
    r.budget(True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('parameter must be keyword-only')
print('Focused budget checks passed')
